objective.statement: Enumerate the assumptions the plan rests on and rate each high / medium / low confidence, flagging every LOW-confidence load-bearing one as a clarify-or-verify trigger.
objective.charter: Near-zero cost, mandatory pre-round for anything at moderate risk or above. This council does not decide anything: it produces the assumption ledger. A required-but-blank field defaults to worst case, never to 'probably fine'.
success_criteria: every load-bearing assumption is listed and rated high / medium / low
each LOW-confidence load-bearing assumption names the probe that would settle it
assumptions the plan does NOT rest on are explicitly excluded so the ledger stays short

context.briefing: One row per assumption: statement, load-bearing yes/no, confidence high/medium/low, and the settling probe if low. Adverse inference on blanks.

roster.display_name: Scope guardian (rejects assumptions the plan does not actually rest on)

expression.producer: stage 'ledger': zero rows with an empty confidence rating AND zero LOW-confidence load-bearing rows without a named settling probe
expression.note: Single-leaf stopping rule: this council is done when the ledger is complete, not when anyone agrees. Edit the rating vocabulary via the producer definition (rating_scale dial).

conditional_decision_requires: every LOW-confidence load-bearing assumption is verified or escalated before execution
